patch_description:
Replace the current shared-line, heavily-parameter-shared block with a symmetry-aware ansatz that:
- Keeps lightweight symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations (corners / edges / center) for parameter efficiency,
- Preserves a CZ lattice backbone for robust entanglement propagation,
- Adds shared parametric center-edge CRZ couplings to let the center modulate edge information,
- Splits the three-qubit ZZZ motif into geometric categories (row / column / diagonal) so the circuit can detect different line types independently,
- Adds doubly-controlled diagonal CCRZ phases to complement diagonal ZZZ motifs,
- Provides separate pre- and post- RZ phases (grouped by symmetry) to increase expressive phase flexibility.

This design balances expressivity (targeted three-qubit motifs aligned to the game's winning triples) and parameter efficiency (symmetry grouping reduces redundant parameters). It reintroduces a motif arrangement that performed well in prior runs (improved validation/test accuracy and low generalization gap). The block keeps all gates within connectivity rules and uses allowed gate types.
